entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The first invasion, begun in 4205 AR by Yawgmoth, in which the Coalition led by Gerrard Capashen faced Phyrexia.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane invaded by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The dark god who planned the invasion for millennia and enters Dominaria as a black cloud of death before being destroyed by the Legacy.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial plane and invading force of Yawgmoth, wrecked layer by layer by the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Leader of the Coalition who duels Urza, kills Crovax, and sacrifices himself to complete the Legacy.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance of Dominarian forces opposing the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew of the skyship Weatherlight who aid battles across Dominaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps the Coalition, defects to Yawgmoth, is decapitated by Gerrard, and sacrifices himself to complete the Legacy.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian commander who leads the first strikes and is killed by Crovax for her failure at Koilos.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Kills Tsabo Tavoc and is killed by Gerrard at the Stronghold.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Archmage who phases out Zhalfir and most of Shiv.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A defender who obliterates Tolaria, himself and the invaders.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Defender of Shiv phased out with Teferi.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Maro-Sorcerer of Yavimaya who defeats the Phyrexians there and overlays the forest onto Urborg.

entities.name: Godwyn
entities.description: A compleated Argivian scholar who devastates Argivian cities until slain by Kari.

entities.name: Kari
entities.description: Godwyn's second-in-command who slays him.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Replaces Thaddeus as co-commander at Koilos and leads armies at Keld and the Stronghold.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Takes control of the Predator and sacrifices himself to complete the Legacy.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: A Shivan dragon who defends Shiv and is turned against mortals after reawakening primeval dragons, ending his own life.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Planeswalkers who counterattack Phyrexia directly, destroying its layers.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who killed Greven il-Vec in a duel.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A Phyrexian-aligned warrior killed by Tahngarth.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax's throne room, later killed by Squee; resurrected in the second invasion.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin who kills Ertai at the Stronghold.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who dies at Koilos and appears as Yawgmoth in disguise in the duel.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Metathran co-commander, unbalanced by Thaddeus's death and later infected by plague.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: Metathran commander lured into Tsabo's lair and dissected.

entities.name: Dralnu
entities.description: A lich lord who joins the Coalition but secretly infects Agnate with plague.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: A weapon completed by the sacrifice of Urza, Gerrard and Karn that destroyed Yawgmoth's essence with white mana.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Phyrexian fortress brought to Urborg in the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The overlay of Rath onto Dominaria that began the second stage.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The Praetor who initiates the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who killed Jaya Ballard and kidnapped Karn in the second invasion.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker killed by the Compleated Ajani at the Battle of the Mana Rig.

events.summary: Yawgmoth begins the invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR after millennia of planning.
events.quote: began in 4205 AR after millennia of planning by the dark god Yawgmoth

events.summary: Phyrexian forces led by Tsabo Tavoc overwhelm Benalia and establish a foothold, though prisoners from Atrivak Mounds are rescued.
events.quote: established a foothold on Dominaria

events.summary: Yavimaya, led by Multani with Gaea's support, destroys or transforms every invading Phyrexian.
events.quote: The result was a total defeat for Phyrexia

events.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir entirely, leaving the Zhalfirin Void, denying Phyrexia its resources.
events.quote: Teferi used the residual energy to phase out Zhalfir entirely, leaving behind the Zhalfirin Void

events.summary: Teferi phases out most of Shiv, taking himself and Jhoira with it.
events.quote: Teferi phased out the majority of Shiv, taking both himself and Jhoira with it

events.summary: Godwyn devastates Argivian cities until his second-in-command Kari slays him.
events.quote: until he was ultimately slain by his second-in-command, Kari

events.summary: Llanowar is defended by Molimo, Multani and the Weatherlight crew, with great losses including King Fhedusil and Takara en-Dal.
events.quote: they succeeded in repelling the Phyrexians with immense effort

events.summary: Phyrexia captures Urborg as a staging ground for the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: Phyrexia succeeded in capturing Urborg as a staging ground for the Rathi Overlay

events.summary: Barrin obliterates Tolaria with himself and the invaders, after sealing his daughter's corpse in a sarcophagus.
events.quote: cast obliterating , erasing himself, the island, its invaders, and all remaining inhabitants and structures

events.summary: At Koilos, Thaddeus is dissected by Tsabo, and Eladamri and Agnate destroy the Gate to Phyrexia; Thaddeus and Hanna die.
events.quote: together they destroyed the Gate to Phyrexia

events.summary: The Rathi Overlay brings Rath's Phyrexian legions onto Dominaria, and Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc for failing at Koilos.
events.quote: Crovax killed Tsabo Tavoc as punishment for her failure at Koilos

events.summary: The Keldon Twilight sweeps the Phyrexian armies away in meltwater, an absolute loss for Phyrexia.
events.quote: this battle was an absolute loss for the Phyrexians

events.summary: The Nine Titans counterattack Phyrexia directly; several are killed and Urza defects to Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Urza defected to the side of Yawgmoth

events.summary: Rhammidarigaaz reawakens the primeval dragons, is turned against mortals, and kills himself after Karn clears his mind.
events.quote: clearing it enough for him to kill himself in an Urborg caldera

events.summary: At the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Karn takes control of the Predator; Ertai steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax, who sends Gerrard into Phyrexia.
events.quote: In a duel, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Karn took control of the Predator

events.summary: Yawgmoth makes Gerrard and Urza duel; Gerrard decapitates Urza and discovers the Hanna he fought for was Yawgmoth in disguise.
events.quote: the duel ended with Gerrard decapitating Urza

events.summary: Multani overlays Yavimaya's forest onto Urborg with Gaea's help to move its defenders.
events.quote: Multani gathered the trees in a five-mile radius

events.summary: The remaining Nine Titans gut Phyrexia, wrecking its first seven spheres.
events.quote: the first seven spheres of Phyrexia were wrecked

events.summary: The Coalition storms the Stronghold as Gerrard kills Crovax and Squee kills Ertai.
events.quote: even as Gerrard killed Crovax and Squee killed Ertai

events.summary: Yawgmoth arrives on Dominaria as a black cloud of death and reanimates the dead; Guff, Bo Levar, Eladamri and Sivvi en-Vec are killed.
events.quote: He appeared as a black cloud of death and reanimated every dead thing on the plane

events.summary: Stone dwarves channel a magma lake that buries the Stronghold's lower levels and pours into Phyrexia.
events.quote: The lower levels of the Stronghold were buried in molten rock

events.summary: The Legacy is completed by the sacrifice of Urza, Gerrard and Karn, destroying Yawgmoth's essence and ending the invasion.
events.quote: the Legacy was completed through the sacrifice of Urza , Gerrard Capashen , and Karn

events.summary: The Second Phyrexian Invasion begins in 4562 AR when Sheoldred arrives via the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: The Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria took place in 4562 AR

events.summary: At the Battle of the Mana Rig the Compleated Ajani kills Jaya Ballard and kidnaps Karn.
events.quote: where the Compleated Ajani killed Jaya Ballard, kidnapped Karn, and the Sylex was lost
